prior_cuda_initialization_regression.command: Python stdin launcher imports torch, runs an 8x8 CUDA matmul to initialize the CUDA/CUBLAS context, then runs unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.test_local_cnn_interaction_updates')
prior_cuda_initialization_regression.scope: Same six tests with CUDA initialized beforehand; verifies integrated-suite isolation rather than medical-model accuracy

cuda_unit_scope.data: Explicit synthetic UNIT native LocalBatch tensors; not medical CT
cuda_unit_scope.optimizer: Fresh fused AdamW on each clone; no saved moments
cuda_unit_scope.precision: FP32 throughout helper, including forward/loss, backward, optimizer, teacher fit and evaluation; caller autocast context is restored
cuda_unit_scope.exact_cuda_parity_test_policy: Identical CUDA UNIT test runs in an isolated Python process with CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before PyTorch import; deterministic algorithms enabled and restored inside child. Parent checks actual one-test PASS with no skip. No CPU/size fallback. Helper preserves caller policy and records it.
cuda_unit_scope.timing_claim: No speedup claim: synchronized update and broader prefix scopes differ; loader/teacher/cache cold-warm effects are recorded
cuda_unit_scope.network: Original full LocalCNN plus PromptGraphModel; no layer/width reduction
checks: Every full-model trainable parameter gradient is present and finite
CNN, readout/fusion, L1 and L2 gradients and cloned parameter updates are measured
Original weights, module types/methods/modes, gradient buffers and caller RNG remain unchanged
Same native query and support data are used in both branches
Scale-zero cloned training matches baseline exactly
Full schedule and selected-support-patient observation coverage cannot be shortened silently
Evaluation callback RNG consumption does not change training dropout/update results
Ambient CPU bfloat16 and CUDA float16 autocast contexts do not change the FP32 cloned-update weights/results
Caller autocast context remains enabled after the nested FP32 helper returns
Runtime deterministic/TF32/matmul precision/cuDNN/CUBLAS and configured autocast dtype are reported
Optional branch progress is separate from step counts, objective and model settings

interpretation: Mechanical unit/operator checks only. This receipt is separate from the root agent's actual CT smoke report and does not establish improved validation ranking or CP usefulness.
